[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (29.7 → 30.4): 과매도 구간 진입 지속, 반등 신호 미약
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-4591.1865 → -2825.4509): 약세 수렴 중 개선 확인, 추세 전환 신호는 아직

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (67,415 KRW) vs SMA5 (69,070 KRW) / SMA20 (92,441 KRW) / SMA50 (100,595 KRW): below short-term trend, below mid-to-long-term trend
· Position relative to SMA100 (130,456 KRW) / SMA200 (112,253 KRW): below mid-to-long-term trend, deepening bearish strength
· 52-week position (21.5%) + approaching historical low range at current price level
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.7 → 30.4): continues in oversold territory, weak rebound signal
· MACD histogram trajectory (-4591.1865 → -2825.4509): improvement confirmed during bearish convergence, trend reversal signal not yet present
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 53,298 KRW): approaching lower band, band width at 84.69% suggests potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing support level (66,180 KRW): higher than Pivot S1 (45,680 KRW)
· Swing resistance level (80,380 KRW): significant distance from current price, potential for trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day / 20-day high-low patterns: sideways phase, insufficient clear trend formation
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.96x): moderate reliability of movement
· Current phase diagnosis: entered oversold territory within a downtrend, short-term rebound possible but trend reversal unconfirmed. Maintain wait-and-see condition.
